_help: Demo content for the fictional Wayfarer brand (portfolio project). People, quotes and ratings are invented. Swap in real, consented entries before any real use; mark placeholders with "sample": true and the production build will refuse to ship them. 'photo' and 'visaImage' are paths under /public/images/students/. 'country' must match a country slug.

testimonials.quote: My counsellor showed my parents the full cost in rupees on day one, including the visa funds. No surprises later, and the loan was sanctioned before my CAS arrived.
I had a two-year gap after my degree. They helped me explain it honestly in my SOP and picked colleges that accept work experience.
The mock visa interviews were the most useful part. By my real interview I could explain my funding and plans in two minutes.
They compared Ireland and the UK for my budget side by side, with the post-study work rules for each. That made the choice easy for my family.
